title: Cute little gadget
text: Cute little gadget. What a cute little gadget for the kitchen! Although at first I didn't know if I would actually use this, I actually think (having used it three times since I received it) will use it often. The color is beautiful (blue) for any cook with the kitchen to match. The ceramic makeup works great as a non-stick and the waffle was prepared flawlessly. My kids absolutely loved this and it cooks waffles quickly and clean up is a breeze. I think this would make a great bridal/shower gift, something unique and handy that can give any chef the edge in making breakfast. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Oster Titanium-Infused DuraCeramic Flip Waffle Maker, Black (CKSTWFBF10W-TECO)
features: Waffle iron lets you quickly create delicious, fluffy waffles
Simple 'flip' operation helps ensure a perfectly shaped, evenly cooked waffle
Titanium-Infused DuraCeramic resists flaking and helps waffles release easily
PFOA- and PTFE-free coating lasts up to 8x longer and cooks up to 30% faster than other nonstick surfaces
Space-saving design can be stored vertically
description: Make Belgian-style waffles at home with the Oster Titanium-Infused DuraCeramic Flip Waffle Maker. This waffle iron allows you to quickly create waffles with an easy 'flip' operation. Simply grab the cool-touch handle and flip over the waffle maker to spread the batter evenly and create a perfectly shaped waffle. Featuring Titanium-Infused DuraCeramic nonstick coating, the waffle maker’s cooking surface is eight times more durable than ordinary nonstick surfaces and resists flaking and peeling. The PFOA- and PTFE- nonstick coating also cooks up to 30 percent faster than ordinary nonstick surfaces. Adjustable temperature control allows you to prepare waffles exactly to your preference. And thanks to a compact design that can be stored vertically, this waffle maker takes up minimal space in your kitchen.
